description: A freshly migrated custom-ID association reached 5/6 pairing and reported idle. Its first close-only counter anchor returned result 3 with byte 17 equal to 00, not the qualified 10 layout. No open was sent and no counter was authenticated.
redaction: Synthetic endpoints; original payloads and CRC residues preserved, checksums recomputed. Radio and command IDs omitted. Private gateway records retain originals; no SDR IQ capture was made.
interpretation: Reception and a command-correlated valve reply are evidenced. Byte 17 semantics remain unproven. Do not broaden the anchor recognizer from this negative reply alone; earlier 00 replies also lack positive follow-up control evidence.
